  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: brew install --cask fuse-t

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-check-linux:
    name: Cargo Check (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  build-desktop-windows:
    name: Build Windows Desktop
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $resourceDir = "${{ github.workspace }}/apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources"
          $out = "$resourceDir/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $resourceDir
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build crypto package
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build

      - uses: tauri-apps/tauri-action@v0
        with:
          projectPath: apps/desktop
          tauriScript: pnpm tauri
          args: -- --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Build debug binary for E2E
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Upload debug desktop binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-debug-windows
          path: apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/cipherbox-desktop.exe
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-desktop-macos:
    name: Build macOS Desktop
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-macos, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: brew install --cask fuse-t

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build crypto package
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build

      - uses: tauri-apps/tauri-action@v0
        with:
          projectPath: apps/desktop
          tauriScript: pnpm tauri
          args: -- --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Build debug binary for E2E
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Upload debug desktop binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-debug-macos
          path: apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/cipherbox-desktop
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-desktop-linux:
    name: Build Linux Desktop
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-linux, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build crypto package
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build

      - uses: tauri-apps/tauri-action@v0
        with:
          projectPath: apps/desktop
          tauriScript: pnpm tauri
          args: -- --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Build debug binary for E2E
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Upload debug desktop binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-debug-linux
          path: apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/cipherbox-desktop
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

lines: - name: Build debug binary for E2E

input.command: python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))" && echo "YAML valid"

content.content: YAML valid

toolUseResult.stdout: YAML valid

input.command:
git add .github/workflows/ci.yml && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(ci): set PKG_CONFIG_PATH for macOS debug desktop build

FUSE-T installs fuse.pc to /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig which isn't in
the default pkg-config search path on macOS ARM64 GitHub runners.
The tauri-action release build succeeds because it uses cached target
artifacts, but the debug build step runs the fuser build script fresh
and fails to find the fuse system library.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

content.text:
**Root cause:** FUSE-T installs `fuse.pc` to `/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/`, which isn't in the default `pkg-config` search path on macOS ARM64 GitHub Actions runners. The `tauri-action` release build succeeds because it reuses cached `target/` artifacts (skipping the fuser build script), but the debug build step runs the build script fresh and `pkg-config` can't find `fuse` or `osxfuse`.

**Fix:** Added `PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig` as an env var on the debug build step.

content:
Ok the macos build is failing on the debug build step. One thing I didn't realise is that having these debug build steps in the main ci workflow is really slowing things down.

Maybe it makes sense to implement something like this:
PR CI only runs the cargo checks (if changes are detected)
once merged to main, run the debug build, execute the e2e desktop suite of test, and only if these pass, then build the production releases. Happy to hear alternative proposals.

   215→          STATUS=$?
   216→          set -e
   217→
   218→          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files

   237→              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
   238→              echo ""
   239→              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."

   245→            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
   246→          fi

1→name: Tag Staging Release
     2→
     3→on:
     4→  workflow_dispatch:
     5→    inputs:
     6→      release_tag:
     7→        description: 'Release tag to deploy (e.g. v0.3.0)'
     8→        required: true
     9→        type: string
    10→
    11→jobs:
    12→  tag-staging:
    13→    name: Create Staging Tag
    14→    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    15→    environment: staging-approval
    16→    permissions:
    17→      contents: write
    18→    outputs:
    19→      staging_tag: ${{ steps.rc.outputs.staging_tag }}
    20→    steps:
    21→      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    22→        with:
    23→          fetch-depth: 0
    24→
    25→      - name: Validate release tag exists
    26→        env:
    27→          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
    28→        run: |
    29→          if ! git rev-parse "refs/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    30→            echo "::error::Tag '${RELEASE_TAG}' does not exist"
    31→            exit 1
    32→          fi
    33→
    34→      - name: Calculate next RC number
    35→        id: rc
    36→        env:
    37→          TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
    38→        run: |
    39→          # Find existing staging RCs for this version
    40→          LAST_RC=$(git tag -l "${TAG}-staging-rc-*" | sed "s/${TAG}-staging-rc-//" | sort -n | tail -1)
    41→          if [ -z "$LAST_RC" ]; then
    42→            NEXT_RC=1
    43→          else
    44→            NEXT_RC=$((LAST_RC + 1))
    45→          fi
    46→          STAGING_TAG="${TAG}-staging-rc-${NEXT_RC}"
    47→          echo "staging_tag=${STAGING_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    48→          echo "## Staging Tag" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
    49→          echo "Creating **${STAGING_TAG}** from ${TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
    50→
    51→      - name: Create and push staging tag
    52→        env:
    53→          STAGING_TAG: ${{ steps.rc.outputs.staging_tag }}
    54→          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
    55→        run: |
    56→          git tag "${STAGING_TAG}" "${RELEASE_TAG}"
    57→          git push origin "${STAGING_TAG}"
    58→
    59→  deploy:
    60→    name: Deploy Staging
    61→    needs: tag-staging
    62→    permissions:
    63→      contents: write
    64→      packages: write
    65→    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml
    66→    with:
    67→      staging_tag: ${{ needs.tag-staging.outputs.staging_tag }}
    68→    secrets: inherit
    69→

1→name: PR Title Lint
     2→
     3→on:
     4→  pull_request:
     5→    types: [opened, edited, synchronize]
     6→
     7→jobs:
     8→  lint-pr-title:
     9→    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    10→    steps:
    11→      - name: Check PR title follows Conventional Commits
    12→        env:
    13→          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
    14→        run: |
    15→          # Conventional Commits pattern: type(optional-scope)(optional-!) : description
    16→          # Types must match commitlint config used by husky
    17→          pattern='^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert)(\(.+\))?(!)?: .+'
    18→
    19→          if [[ ! "$PR_TITLE" =~ $pattern ]]; then
    20→            echo "::error::PR title does not follow Conventional Commits format."
    21→            echo ""
    22→            echo "Expected: <type>(<optional scope>): <description>"
    23→            echo "Got:      $PR_TITLE"
    24→            echo ""
    25→            echo "Valid types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert"
    26→            echo "Examples:"
    27→            echo "  feat: add file sharing"
    28→            echo "  fix(api): handle null vault ID"
    29→            echo "  chore: update dependencies"
    30→            exit 1
    31→          fi
    32→
    33→          # Check for parenthesized text in the description (after "type(scope): ")
    34→          # This breaks Release Please's conventional commit parser which
    35→          # misinterprets parens as a malformed scope.
    36→          description="${PR_TITLE#*: }"
    37→          if [[ "$description" =~ \(.+\) ]]; then
    38→            echo "::error::PR title description must not contain parenthesized text (e.g., \"(some words)\")."
    39→            echo ""
    40→            echo "Release Please's commit parser misinterprets parentheses in the"
    41→            echo "description as a malformed scope, causing silent release failures."
    42→            echo ""
    43→            echo "Got: $PR_TITLE"
    44→            echo ""
    45→            echo "Instead, use dashes, brackets, or remove the parens:"
    46→            echo "  feat: Phase 11 — Windows Desktop - WinFsp virtual filesystem"
    47→            echo "  feat: Phase 11 — Windows Desktop [WinFsp virtual filesystem]"
    48→            exit 1
    49→          fi
    50→
    51→          echo "PR title is valid: $PR_TITLE"
    52→

Perfect! I have everything I need to provide a comprehensive map of the CI/CD pipeline. Let me now provide the detailed analysis:

## Comprehensive CI/CD Workflow Map for CipherBox

### Overview
The repository has 8 GitHub workflows:
1. **ci.yml** — Main CI pipeline for code quality, builds, and desktop binaries
2. **e2e.yml** — Web app E2E tests
3. **e2e-desktop.yml** — Desktop E2E tests (triggered after CI succeeds)
4. **deploy-staging.yml** — Staging deployment (triggered by staging tags)
5. **tag-staging.yml** — Manual staging tag creation and deployment
6. **release-please.yml** — Automated release management
7. **pr-title.yml** — PR title validation
8. **claude-code.yml** — Claude Code agent integration

---

## 1. CI Pipeline (`ci.yml`)

**Trigger:** `push` to `main` or `pull_request` to `main`

### Job Dependency Graph:
```
changes (always)
  ├─→ lint (always, no deps)
  ├─→ typecheck (needs: changes) [conditional]
  ├─→ api-spec (needs: changes) [conditional]
  ├─→ migration-check (needs: changes) [conditional]
  └─→ test (needs: changes, lint, typecheck) [conditional]
       └─→ build (needs: changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check) [conditional]
           ├─→ cargo-check-windows (needs: changes, lint) [conditional]
           │   └─→ build-desktop-windows (needs: changes, cargo-check-windows, typecheck) [conditional]
           ├─→ cargo-check-macos (needs: changes, lint) [conditional]
           │   └─→ build-desktop-macos (needs: changes, cargo-check-macos, typecheck) [conditional]
           └─→ cargo-check-linux (needs: changes, lint) [conditional]
               └─→ build-desktop-linux (needs: changes, cargo-check-linux, typecheck) [conditional]
```

### Changes Detection Job

**Name:** `changes`  
**Runs-on:** ubuntu-latest  
**Outputs:**
- `src` — True if source code changed
- `desktop` — True if desktop code changed

**Paths triggering `src`:**
- `apps/**`, `packages/**`, `tee-worker/**`, `tests/**`
- `.github/**`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `tsconfig*.json`, `biome.json`

**Paths triggering `desktop`:**
- `apps/desktop/src/**`, `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**`, `apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**`
- `apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**`, `apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**`
- `apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml`, `apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock`, `apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs`, `apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml`
- `apps/desktop/index.html`, `apps/desktop/vite.config.*`, `apps/desktop/tsconfig*`
- `packages/crypto/src/**`, `packages/crypto/tsconfig*`
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

### Core Jobs

#### `lint` (runs unconditionally)
- No dependencies
- Installs pnpm + Node 22, runs `pnpm lint`
- **Blocks:** typecheck, test, cargo-check-* (via `!failure()`)

#### `typecheck` (conditional: push OR src==true)
- **Condition:** `github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'`
- Runs `pnpm typecheck`

#### `api-spec` (conditional: push OR src==true)
- Services: PostgreSQL 16, IPFS Kubo v0.34.0
- Runs `pnpm api:generate` to rebuild OpenAPI spec and API client
- **Verifies:** Generated files in `apps/web/src/api/` and `packages/api-client/openapi.json` are up-to-date
- **Failure Mode:** If generated files aren't committed, CI fails

#### `migration-check` (conditional: push OR src==true)
- Service: PostgreSQL 16
- Runs TypeORM migration generator to detect entity/migration drift
- Filters out cosmetic constraint/index name differences
- **Failure Mode:** If structural changes detected without corresponding migrations

#### `test` (conditional: push OR src==true, depends on lint + typecheck)
- Services: PostgreSQL 16, IPFS Kubo v0.34.0
- Runs API tests (`pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov`)
- Runs Crypto tests (`pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage`)
- **Uploads coverage to Codecov** (via `codecov/codecov-action@v5`)

#### `build` (conditional: push OR src==true, depends on all previous jobs)
- Builds crypto, API, and web packages only (excludes desktop)
- **Blocks:** If this fails, desktop builds don't start

### Desktop Build Pipeline

**Only runs if:** `github.event_name == 'push' OR needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'`

#### `cargo-check-windows` (windows-latest)
- Installs WinFsp v2.1.25156 (hash-verified)
- Runs `cargo check --no-default-features --features winfsp`

#### `cargo-check-macos` (macos-latest)
- Installs FUSE-T via brew
- Runs `cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse`

#### `cargo-check-linux` (ubuntu-22.04)
- Installs libfuse3-dev and other system deps
- Runs `cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse`

#### `build-desktop-windows`
- Depends on: cargo-check-windows, typecheck
- Installs WinFsp (hash-verified)
- Runs `tauri-apps/tauri-action@v0` with `--features winfsp`
- Builds debug binary for E2E: `cargo build --no-default-features --features winfsp`
- **Uploads artifact:** `desktop-debug-windows` (retention: 1 day)

#### `build-desktop-macos`
- Depends on: cargo-check-macos, typecheck
- Installs FUSE-T via brew
- Runs `tauri-apps/tauri-action@v0` with `--features fuse`
- Builds debug binary for E2E: `cargo build --no-default-features --features fuse`
- **Uploads artifact:** `desktop-debug-macos` (retention: 1 day)

#### `build-desktop-linux`
- Depends on: cargo-check-linux, typecheck
- Installs system deps (libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev, fuse3, etc.)
- Runs `tauri-apps/tauri-action@v0` with `--features fuse`
- Builds debug binary for E2E: `cargo build --no-default-features --features fuse`
- **Uploads artifact:** `desktop-debug-linux` (retention: 1 day)

---

## 2. E2E Web Tests (`e2e.yml`)

**Trigger:** `push` to `main`, `pull_request` to `main`, or manual `workflow_dispatch`

**Runs-on:** ubuntu-latest (15-minute timeout)

**Services:** PostgreSQL 16, IPFS v0.34.0, Redis 7

**Key Steps:**
1. Sets up Node 22 + pnpm 10
2. Installs Playwright browsers (Chromium)
3. Builds mock-ipns-routing tool
4. Builds crypto and API packages
5. Creates `.env` files for Web3Auth
6. Runs `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/e2e test`

**Environment Variables:**
- Database: PostgreSQL 16 (localhost:5432)
- IPFS: Kubo v0.34.0 (localhost:5001 API, 8080 gateway)
- Redis: localhost:6379
- API URL: http://localhost:3000
- IPNS routing: http://localhost:3001 (mock service)

**Artifacts on Failure:**
- `playwright-report/` and `test-results/` (7-day retention)

---

## 3. Desktop E2E Tests (`e2e-desktop.yml`)

**Trigger:** `workflow_run` (after CI completes successfully) or manual `workflow_dispatch`

**Runs on:** `macos-latest`, `windows-latest`, `ubuntu-22.04` (matrix, fail-fast: false, 30-minute timeout)

**Workflow Dispatch Option:** Can specify CI `run_id` to download binaries from; auto-finds latest if not specified

### Per-Platform Setup:

#### macOS
- Installs FUSE-T via brew
- Installs Redis via brew
- Backend: FUSE-T (SMB backend), uses `diskutil unmount force` for cleanup
- Artifact: `desktop-debug-macos`

#### Linux
- System deps: libfuse3-dev, fuse3, libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0, libayatana-appindicator3-1
- Installs Redis via apt
- Uses xvfb for display (via `GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1`)
- Backend: Kernel FUSE, uses `fusermount3 -u` for cleanup
- Artifact: `desktop-debug-linux`

#### Windows
- Installs WinFsp via MSI (hash-verified)
- Installs Redis via Chocolatey (v6.4)
- Backend: SMB via WinFsp
- Uses PowerShell scripts for env setup
- Artifact: `desktop-debug-windows`

### Common Test Sequence:
1. Downloads debug binary from CI artifact
2. Sets up PostgreSQL (via ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres)
3. Installs Kubo IPFS daemon
4. Starts Redis
5. Installs Node 22 + pnpm 10
6. Builds crypto and API packages
7. Runs migrations
8. Starts mock IPNS routing service
9. Starts API server on port 3000
10. Launches desktop app with `--dev-key <random-32-byte-hex>`
11. Runs platform-specific test suite: `bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh` or `tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.ps1`
12. Cleans up desktop and FUSE/SMB mounts

**Failure Artifacts:**
- API logs, FUSE-T logs (7-day retention)

---

## 4. Staging Deployment (`deploy-staging.yml`)

**Trigger:**
- Push tag matching `v*-staging*` (git tag trigger)
- `workflow_call` from `tag-staging.yml`

**Environment:** `staging`

### Jobs (run in sequence):

#### `build-api` (ubuntu-latest)
- Builds Docker image from `apps/api/Dockerfile`
- Pushes to `ghcr.io/{OWNER}/cipherbox-api:{TAG}` and `:latest`

#### `build-tee` (ubuntu-latest)
- Builds Docker image from `tee-worker/Dockerfile`
- Pushes to `ghcr.io/{OWNER}/cipherbox-tee-worker:{TAG}` and `:latest`

#### `build-web` (ubuntu-latest, environment: staging)
- Uses staging environment vars: `VITE_API_URL`, `VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID`, etc.
- Builds crypto, then web package
- **Uploads artifact:** `web-dist` (1-day retention)

#### `build-desktop` macOS + Windows (environment: staging)
- macOS: Installs FUSE-T, builds with `--features fuse`
- Windows: Installs WinFsp, builds with `--features winfsp`
- Uses `tauri-apps/tauri-action@v0`
- Creates GitHub Release (prerelease) with built binaries

#### `deploy-vps` (depends on build-api, build-tee, build-web)
- Host: `vars.STAGING_HOST` (76.13.151.200)
- Generates `.env.staging` from secrets/vars
- SCP copies: `.env.staging`, `docker-compose.staging.yml`, `Caddyfile`, `alloy-config.river`
- SCP copies web dist to `/opt/cipherbox/web`
- SSH script:
  - Moves files to correct locations
  - Copies `.env.staging` → `.env` (for Docker Compose substitution)
  - Sets permissions to 600
  - Creates symlink for Caddy certs
  - Logs into GHCR
  - Runs `docker compose pull` (pulls new images)
  - Runs migrations: `docker compose run --rm api node dist/run-migrations.js`
  - Starts/restarts services: `docker compose up -d`
  - Restarts Caddy to pick up new web files
  - Prunes old images

---

## 5. Tag Staging Release (`tag-staging.yml`)

**Trigger:** Manual `workflow_dispatch` with input `release_tag` (e.g., `v0.3.0`)

**Jobs:**

#### `tag-staging` (ubuntu-latest, environment: staging-approval)
- Validates release tag exists via git
- Calculates next RC number by finding existing `{TAG}-staging-rc-*` tags
- **Output:** `staging_tag` (e.g., `v0.3.0-staging-rc-1`)
- Creates and pushes staging tag: `git tag {STAGING_TAG} {RELEASE_TAG}`

#### `deploy` (calls deploy-staging.yml)
- **Needs:** tag-staging outputs
- Uses `workflow_call` to invoke deploy-staging.yml with `staging_tag` parameter

**Convention:** Staging tags are named `v<version>-staging-rc-<N>` (e.g., `v0.1.2-staging-rc-1`)

---

## 6. Release Please (`release-please.yml`)

**Trigger:** `push` to `main`

**Single Job:** `release-please` (ubuntu-latest)

**Process:**
1. Uses GitHub App token (via `actions/create-github-app-token@v1`)
2. Runs `googleapis/release-please-action@v4`
3. Config files:
   - `release-please-config.json` (version bump rules, changelog generation)
   - `.release-please-manifest.json` (current version tracking)
4. Creates PR with version bumps and changelog
5. When PR merged, Release Please creates GitHub Release and `vX.Y.Z` tag

**Version Propagation:**
- All packages share unified version
- Bumps: `package.json` (all), `Cargo.toml`, `tauri.conf.json`

**Release Push:** Triggers any workflows listening for tag pushes (e.g., staging deploy if tag matches `v*-staging*`)

---

## 7. PR Title Validation (`pr-title.yml`)

**Trigger:** `pull_request` (opened, edited, synchronize)

**Validation Rules:**
- Must follow Conventional Commits: `<type>(<optional-scope>): <description>`
- Valid types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert
- **CRITICAL:** Description must NOT contain parentheses (e.g., `(some words)`) — Release Please's parser misinterprets them

---

## 8. Claude Code Integration (`claude-code.yml`)

**Trigger:** Issue comments, PR review comments, PR reviews, or new issues containing `@claude`

**Permissions:** write access to contents, pull-requests, issues; read on actions

**Action:** `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1`

---

## Key Architectural Patterns

### 1. Changes Detection Pattern
- Single `changes` job detects which parts changed
- All downstream jobs use `if: github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.{src|desktop} == 'true'`
- Avoids running expensive jobs (typecheck, test, builds) on PRs with only doc changes

### 2. Desktop Build Parallelization
- Three independent cargo-check jobs (Windows, macOS, Linux) run in parallel
- Each cargo-check feeds into its own build job
- All use platform-specific FUSE driver + crypto+dependencies
- Tauri handles release binary creation; separate debug binary build for E2E

### 3. Staging Deployment
- Staging is triggered by git tags matching `v*-staging*`
- CI builds debug binaries (1-day retention) for E2E
- Staging release builds full release binaries and creates GitHub Release
- Docker images pushed to GHCR with tag + latest
- VPS deployment via SSH + SCP using Caddy reverse proxy

### 4. E2E Test Infrastructure
- Web E2E: Runs on Ubuntu with services (PostgreSQL, IPFS, Redis)
- Desktop E2E: Triggered after CI succeeds, runs on all three platforms
- Both use same mock-ipns-routing tool for delegated routing
- Desktop E2E downloads binaries from CI artifacts (1-day window)

### 5. Release Process
- Release Please automates version bumping + changelog
- Single unified version across all packages
- Manual staging tag creation via `tag-staging.yml` → auto-deploys via `deploy-staging.yml`
- Production release via Release Please PR → GitHub Release + tag

---

## Critical Sequences

### PR → Main → Production
1. PR triggers: ci.yml (lint, typecheck, test, build)
2. PR title validated (Conventional Commits format)
3. Merge to main triggers: release-please.yml
4. Release Please creates PR with version bumps
5. Merge release PR → GitHub Release + vX.Y.Z tag
6. Tag push → Deploy staging (if tag matches `v*-staging*`)

### Manual Staging Deploy
1. Run tag-staging.yml manually with release tag (e.g., v0.3.0)
2. tag-staging calculates next RC number
3. Creates and pushes `v0.3.0-staging-rc-1` tag
4. Tag push triggers deploy-staging.yml
5. Builds API, TEE, Web Docker images + Desktop binaries
6. Deploys via SSH/SCP to staging VPS

### Desktop E2E Testing
1. CI builds debug binaries for all three platforms (1-day retention)
2. e2e-desktop.yml triggered after CI completes
3. Downloads binary for each platform from CI artifacts
4. Sets up backend services (PostgreSQL, IPFS, Redis)
5. Launches desktop app with random dev key
6. Runs platform-specific test script

---

## File Paths Reference

- **Workflows:** `/Users/michael/Code/cipher-box/.github/workflows/*.yml`
- **Desktop code:** `apps/desktop/src/`, `apps/desktop/src-tauri/`
- **API:** `apps/api/`
- **Web:** `apps/web/`
- **Crypto package:** `packages/crypto/`
- **E2E web tests:** `tests/e2e/`
- **E2E desktop tests:** `tests/e2e-desktop/`
- **Mock IPNS routing:** `tools/mock-ipns-routing/`
- **TEE worker:** `tee-worker/`
- **Docker files:** `apps/api/Dockerfile`, `tee-worker/Dockerfile`, `docker/docker-compose.staging.yml`

This is the complete CI/CD pipeline structure for CipherBox.

# Plan: Restructure Desktop CI Pipeline

## Context

The desktop build jobs in `ci.yml` currently run on both PRs and pushes to main. Each platform builds **twice** per run — once via `tauri-action` (release) and once via `cargo build` (debug for E2E). This is slow (~10+ min per platform) and blocks PR merges unnecessarily. The macOS debug build is also currently broken due to a `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` issue.

**Goal:** Fast PR CI with only compilation checks; full desktop builds only on main where they feed into E2E testing.

## Current Flow

```
PR push → ci.yml:
  lint, typecheck, test, build (web/api)
  cargo-check (3 platforms)         ← fast (~2-3 min)
  build-desktop (3 platforms)       ← slow (~10+ min each, runs tauri-action + debug build)

Merge to main → ci.yml runs again → e2e-desktop.yml triggers (downloads debug artifacts, runs E2E)

Staging tag → deploy-staging.yml (builds production release binaries via tauri-action)
```

## Proposed Flow

```
PR push → ci.yml:
  lint, typecheck, test, build (web/api)
  cargo-check (3 platforms)         ← validates compilation, fast

Merge to main → ci.yml:
  same as PR + build-desktop (3 platforms, debug only)
  → e2e-desktop.yml triggers (downloads debug artifacts, runs E2E)

Staging tag → deploy-staging.yml (builds production release binaries, unchanged)
```

## Changes

### 1. Remove `tauri-action` from desktop build jobs in `ci.yml`

The `tauri-action` step does a full release build in each desktop job. This is redundant — `deploy-staging.yml` already has its own `tauri-action` for production releases. Remove it from all 3 platform build jobs, keeping only the debug binary build + artifact upload.

**Files:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (lines ~566, ~631, ~510 area)

### 2. Gate desktop build jobs to only run on push to main

Change the `if` condition on `build-desktop-{macos,windows,linux}` from:
```yaml
if: |
  !failure() && !cancelled() &&
  (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
```
to:
```yaml
if: |
  !failure() && !cancelled() &&
  github.event_name == 'push' &&
  needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
```

This means desktop builds only happen on pushes to main with desktop changes. PRs still get `cargo-check` validation.

### 3. Fix macOS debug build `PKG_CONFIG_PATH`

The existing fix from the previous commit needs to stay (already done), but also remove the `tauri-action` step which was masking the issue via cached artifacts.

### 4. Remove `Build {macOS,Windows,Linux} Desktop` from required PR status checks

Since these jobs won't run on PRs anymore, remove them from branch protection. The `Cargo Check` jobs remain as required checks.

**Method:** `gh api` call to update branch protection rules.

### 5. Remove Cargo cache for desktop builds (optional cleanup)

With tauri-action removed, the cargo cache in desktop build jobs only needs to cache the debug build. The cache key and paths remain the same but the cache will be smaller without release artifacts.

## Files Modified

1. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — Remove tauri-action steps, change if-conditions on build-desktop jobs
2. Branch protection rules — Remove 3 build checks via GitHub API

## Verification

1. Push the changes on this branch — verify PR CI skips desktop build jobs (only cargo-check runs)
2. Check that cargo-check jobs still run and pass on PR
3. After merge, verify desktop build jobs run on main push and upload debug artifacts
4. Verify e2e-desktop.yml can still download and use the artifacts

# Plan: Restructure Desktop CI Pipeline

## Context

The desktop build jobs in `ci.yml` currently run on both PRs and pushes to main. Each platform builds **twice** per run — once via `tauri-action` (release) and once via `cargo build` (debug for E2E). This is slow (~10+ min per platform) and blocks PR merges unnecessarily. The macOS debug build is also currently broken due to a `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` issue.

**Goal:** Fast PR CI with only compilation checks; full desktop builds only on main where they feed into E2E testing.

## Current Flow

```
PR push → ci.yml:
  lint, typecheck, test, build (web/api)
  cargo-check (3 platforms)         ← fast (~2-3 min)
  build-desktop (3 platforms)       ← slow (~10+ min each, runs tauri-action + debug build)

Merge to main → ci.yml runs again → e2e-desktop.yml triggers (downloads debug artifacts, runs E2E)

Staging tag → deploy-staging.yml (builds production release binaries via tauri-action)
```

## Proposed Flow

```
PR push → ci.yml:
  lint, typecheck, test, build (web/api)
  cargo-check (3 platforms)         ← validates compilation, fast

Merge to main → ci.yml:
  same as PR + build-desktop (3 platforms, debug only)
  → e2e-desktop.yml triggers (downloads debug artifacts, runs E2E)

Staging tag → deploy-staging.yml (builds production release binaries, unchanged)
```

### 1. Remove `tauri-action` from desktop build jobs in `ci.yml`

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4

      - name: Install dependencies

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: brew install --cask fuse-t

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git

          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}

    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

          path: |

          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

    name: Cargo Check (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |

            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature

  build-desktop-windows:
    name: Build Windows Desktop
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows, typecheck]
    if: |

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:

  build-desktop-macos:
    name: Build macOS Desktop
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-macos, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: brew install --cask fuse-t

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Build debug binary for E2E
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Upload debug desktop binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-debug-macos
          path: apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/cipherbox-desktop
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-desktop-linux:
    name: Build Linux Desktop
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-linux, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build crypto package
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build

      - uses: tauri-apps/tauri-action@v0
        with:
          projectPath: apps/desktop
          tauriScript: pnpm tauri
          args: -- --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Build debug binary for E2E
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Upload debug desktop binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-debug-linux
          path: apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/cipherbox-desktop
          retention-days: 1

ci: remove tauri-action from desktop builds and gate to main only

Desktop build jobs in ci.yml were running on both PRs and pushes,
with redundant tauri-action release builds (deploy-staging.yml
already handles production releases). This slowed PR CI by ~10min

**Branch protection updated:**

**New CI flow:**
